subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw split this umbrella into native tool batching, context block lifecycle, and plan enforcement tracks, and which parts belong in core runtime/API versus plugins or ClawHub?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, persisted context semantics, new settings/config, and runner enforcement policy; repository guidance treats those as compatibility- and product-sensitive decisions rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Narrower Issues
options.body: Make the context and workflow-mode issues canonical for their portions and open or keep a separate batch-tools tracker if maintainers want that work independently.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the umbrella if maintainers decide plan enforcement and context-block semantics are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across planning, strict-agentic execution, file tools, and context pruning, making him the best available routing owner for the product split.
